title: NNSA's 80-pit two-site objective remains a capacity target, not qualified output
summary: NNSA states a goal of no fewer than 80 pits per year as close to 2030 as possible; GAO describes the planned 30-per-year Los Alamos and 50-per-year Savannah River capacity components.
